parsed.observations: Green leaf blade with numerous yellow to lemon-orange pustules arranged in long parallel stripes along the veins, with surrounding yellowing. Some areas are blurred, but the striped pustules are clearly visible. No white powdery growth or black-dotted necrotic blotches are visible.
parsed.summary: Visible yellow to lemon-orange pustules forming parallel stripes along leaf veins strongly support yellow rust (stripe rust).
